d: Watch this video as Firstpost explains how an explosive geopolitical crisis is hurtling the Horn of Africa toward all-out war, following sensational allegations from Addis Ababa. Ethiopia's Chief of General Staff has accused Eritrea of masterminding a covert multi-front conspiracy—coordinating with Egypt, Sudan, and rebel factions including the TPLF, Fano fighters, and Oromo armed groups—with the ultimate objective to "bury Ethiopia" and topple Prime Minister Abiy Ahmed's government. Amid reports of heavy artillery exchanges, drone strikes near the disputed Badme border, and mounting…
